import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int ROOM = -1;
    static final int REAC = -2;
    static final int BAD_REAC = -3;
    static final int CAPSULE = ROOM;
    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static int[][] maze = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] capsuleCount = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][][] tox;
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static List<Coord> civilians = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Coord> capsules = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Coord {
        int x, y, amount;
        Coord(int a, int b, int c) {
            x = a; y = b; amount = c;
        }
    }

    static boolean passable(int x, int y, int n) {
        return x >= 0 && x < n && y >= 0 && y < n && maze[x][y] == ROOM;
    }

    static int typeOf(char c) {
        if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') return ROOM;
        if (c == 'Y') return REAC;
        if (c == 'Z') return BAD_REAC;
        return -1;
    }

    static int amtOf(char c) {
        return c - '0';
    }

    static void spread(int x, int y, int T, int n) {
        tox[0][x][y] = 1;
        for (int t = 1; t <= T; ++t) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                    if (tox[t-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        tox[t][i][j] = 1;
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                            int nx = i + dx[d];
                            int ny = j + dy[d];
                            if (passable(nx, ny, n)) {
                                tox[t][nx][ny] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int pathTime(Coord a, Coord b, int n, int T) {
        boolean[][] used = new boolean[n][n];
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{0, a.x, a.y});
        used[a.x][a.y] = true;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int t = cur[0];
            int x = cur[1];
            int y = cur[2];
            if (x == b.x && y == b.y) return t;
            if (t == T) continue;
            if (tox[t][x][y] == 1) continue;
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; ++d) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (passable(nx, ny, n) && !used[nx][ny] && tox[t][nx][ny] == 0) {
                    used[nx][ny] = true;
                    q.add(new int[]{t+1, nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        return 999;
    }

    static class ResidualNet {
        int n;
        int[][] residual;
        int[] visited;

        ResidualNet(int _n) {
            n = _n;
            residual = new int[_n][_n];
            visited = new int[_n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity) {
            residual[u][v] += capacity;
        }

        int findPath(int u, int t, int pushed) {
            if (u == t) return pushed;
            visited[u] = 1;
            for (int v = 0; v < n; ++v) {
                if (visited[v] == 0 && residual[u][v] > 0) {
                    int got = findPath(v, t, Math.min(pushed, residual[u][v]));
                    if (got > 0) {
                        residual[u][v] -= got;
                        residual[v][u] += got;
                        return got;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long total = 0;
            while (true) {
                Arrays.fill(visited, 0);
                int pushed = findPath(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                total += pushed;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline

        Coord badReactor = new Coord(0, 0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = typeOf(ch);
                int amount = amtOf(ch);
                maze[i][j] = type;
                if (type == ROOM && amount > 0) {
                    civilians.add(new Coord(i, j, amount));
                }
                if (type == BAD_REAC) {
                    badReactor = new Coord(i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                int type = typeOf(ch);
                int amount = amtOf(ch);
                if (type == CAPSULE && amount > 0) {
                    capsules.add(new Coord(i, j, amount));
                    capsuleCount[i][j] = amount;
                }
            }
        }

        tox = new int[T+1][N][N];
        spread(badReactor.x, badReactor.y, T, N);

        ResidualNet net = new ResidualNet(MAXN);
        int source = 0;
        int sink = MAXN - 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < civilians.size(); ++i) {
            net.addEdge(source, i * 2 + 1, civilians.get(i).amount);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < capsules.size(); ++i) {
            net.addEdge(i * 2 + 2, sink, capsules.get(i).amount);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < civilians.size(); ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capsules.size(); ++j) {
                int t = pathTime(civilians.get(i), capsules.get(j), N, T);
                if (t <= T) {
                    net.addEdge(i * 2 + 1, j * 2 + 2, 999);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(net.maxFlow(source, sink));
        sc.close();
    }
}
